# The plugin the bundle assembled. The export inside it is asserted whole, byte for byte, against the
# export it was copied from, so nothing here lists its files a second time.
.dist/plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
.dist/plugin/bundle.json
.dist/plugin/skills/glossary-lookup/SKILL.md

# A file under no component's path travels regardless.
.dist/plugin/README.md

# The trimmed component's words never reach the plugin. A skill that finds nothing is worse than an
# absent one: it answers, and answers with nothing.
!.dist/plugin/skills/decision-lookup/SKILL.md

# The marketplace sits at the root, because a marketplace resolves a plugin source against the
# directory holding `.claude-plugin/` and refuses one containing `..`.
.dist/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json

# The export the bundle copied from is left where it was. `bundle` reads it and never writes back, and
# the two commands own separate directories under one root for exactly that reason.
.dist/export/manifest.json
.dist/export/glossary/terms.jsonl
